description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan transaction interest payment waivers in the Apache Fineract project. It includes several test cases verifying different scenarios such as interest payment waivers, validation errors, reverse payments, chargebacks, batch operations, and advanced payment allocations with both horizontal and vertical repayment processing strategies.

classes.name: LoanTransactionInterestPaymentWaiverTest
classes.description: Java class containing integration tests for interest payment waivers on loans within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, configures REST API specifications, and creates necessary accounts and a client.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionForProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Tests applying an interest payment waiver on a progressive loan schedule and verifies transaction and schedule updates.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionValidationErrorTests
methods.description: Verifies validation errors occur when attempting invalid interest payment waiver transactions.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionForProgressiveLoanWithExternalTransactionId
methods.description: Tests interest waiver transactions assigned with external IDs and retrieval by external ID.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionReversePaymentForProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Verifies reversal of interest waiver payments and their effects on transactions and schedules.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionChargeBackForProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Tests chargeback process after interest waiver and the resulting adjustments.

methods.name: applyAndApproveLoanProgressiveAdvancedPaymentAllocationStrategyMonthlyRepayments
methods.description: Helper method to apply and approve a loan with progressive payment strategy and monthly repayments.

methods.name: applyLoanRequestProgressiveAdvancedPaymentAllocationStrategyMonthlyRepayments
methods.description: Constructs a loan application request with specific parameters for progressive advanced payment strategy.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC3
methods.description: Scenario test for interest waiver in a loan with overpayment and impact on balance and schedule.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC12
methods.description: Scenario test for refunding last installment after interest waiver in an advanced payment scenario.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC13
methods.description: Scenario testing vertical repayment processing with interest payment waiver and charges.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC15
methods.description: Tests interest waiver in a complex scenario involving charges, refunds, and overpayments.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC17c
methods.description: Test case for full refund with chargeback in a loan scenario involving goodwill credit.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC112
methods.description: Tests advanced payment allocation with horizontal repayment processing involving charges and interest waiver.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverUC113
methods.description: Tests interest waiver with vertical repayment processing, add charges, and advance payments.

methods.name: testAccounting
methods.description: Tests the accounting entries and balances after interest waivers, charges, payments, and reversals, including accrual accounting scenarios.

methods.name: testInterestPaymentWaiverTransactionAccountingAccuralForInterestPenaltyFeeOverpaymentChargeOFFLoan
methods.description: Tests interest waiver transactions with charge-off, overpayment, and subsequent reversals, focusing on account balancing and journal entries under accrual accounting.
